caption: The drawing depicts a standing male figure shown in profile, wearing a long, bright red robe that reaches his ankles. The figure has a tan complexion and a long, pointed black beard, with equally long and wavy black hair flowing down the back. On his head, he wears a crown of thorns in a dark, brownish-gray color. His facial features are accentuated, with black eyebrows, a pronounced nose, red lips, and a stylized black goatee; there are red marks on his face and forehead. His hands, also tan, are positioned in front of his body, the right hand appearing to be loosely closed. He stands on a gray base wearing light brown sandals. To the right of the main profile view, there is an inset showing a straight-on view of the figure's head and neck. This detail emphasizes the crown of thorns, black hair and beard, red marks on the forehead, and the same facial features as the profile. The background is plain and off-white, and the drawing is signed at the bottom right by Majel G. Claflin.
title: Santo "Christo"
